records.subject: 0.7 M CuSO4 aqueous electrolyte with 0.1 M H2SO4
records.object: P-max improvement up to 100%; reported value similar to 1.6 μW cm−2
records.quote: Experimental testing revealed an optimum concentration of 0.7 M CuSO4 aqueous electrolyte, with the addition of 0.1 M H2SO4 as background electrolyte, results in P-max improvements of up to 100%, from to similar to 1.6 mu W cm(-2), in a horizontal cell operating between the vertical cold and hot copper (Cu) electrode temperatures of 5 and 65 C, respectively.
modality_evidence: Experimental testing revealed an optimum concentration of 0.7 M CuSO4 aqueous electrolyte, with the addition of 0.1 M H2SO4 as background electrolyte, results in P-max improvements of up to 100%, from to similar to 1.6 mu W cm(-2), in a horizontal cell operating between the vertical cold and hot copper (Cu) electrode temperatures of 5 and 65 C, respectively.
records.conditions: Reported optimum concentration; horizontal cell with vertical cold and hot Cu electrodes at 5 and 65 °C, respectively.
